headline: EU locks in AI Act delay; Meituan open-sources big model
body: A quiet day. The EU Council gave final approval to delaying the AI Act's high-risk rules, a small hit to Global Coordination. Meituan open-sourced a 1.6-trillion-parameter model reportedly trained on Chinese chips, spreading power away from a few labs, and Meta showed a non-invasive brain-to-text decoder, edging Human-AI Merging up. Horizon Balance: +0.57.
movers_note: Small moves: Libertarian Utopia +0.1 and Descendants +0.1, from Meituan's open model and Meta's brain decoder.
coming_up: AI Act omnibus publication in the EU Official Journal expected in July
Original EU AI Act high-risk deadline of August 2, 2026 is now postponed
